title: What If Apophis Hit? Most Videos Get It Wrong
topic: Myth-busting ride on asteroid 99942 Apophis during its 13 April 2029 flyby: the scary claims, low gravity, the 2004 scare and its discoverers, passing inside the geostationary ring, tidal shivers, what a hit would really do (regional, not global), the honest unknown about tsunamis, OSIRIS-APEX and RAMSES, two billion people watching
